description: Semi-dwarf 1 (SD1); gibberellin 20-oxidase; the rice 'Green Revolution' plant-height gene.
Grain Size 3 (GS3); a major QTL controlling rice grain length.
Granule-bound starch synthase I (Waxy); controls endosperm amylose content.
Heading date 3a (Hd3a); rice florigen, ortholog of Arabidopsis FT.
Heading date 1 (Hd1); photoperiod flowering-time regulator, ortholog of Arabidopsis CONSTANS.
